scenes.visual: close-up photo of the glass door of a white microwave oven on an Indian kitchen counter, the black dotted metal mesh behind the glass filling most of the frame, a bowl of dal glowing in the warm light inside, slight low angle, sharp focus on the mesh

narration.en: Why does every microwave door have this black *mesh*?
narration.hi: Microwave ke darwaze pe ye kaali *jaali* kyun hoti hai?

scenes.visual: 2D animation: side view of the oven, a red microwave bouncing wall to wall, one wavelength measured as 12 cm

narration.en: Inside, the oven is full of microwaves. Each wave is about *12 centimetres* long.
narration.hi: Oven ke andar microwaves bhari hoti hain. Aur har wave lagbhag *12 centimetre* lambi hoti hai.

scenes.visual: extreme macro photo of a microwave oven door: a black metal sheet full of tiny round holes in a neat grid, seen straight on through the glass, warm yellow light from inside glowing through the holes

narration.en: Now look closer. That mesh is *metal*, full of holes just a millimetre or two wide.
narration.hi: Ab zara paas se dekho. Ye jaali *metal* ki hai, aur iske chhed sirf ek-do millimetre ke hain.

scenes.visual: 2D animation: a big red microwave hits the metal mesh and bounces back, tiny yellow light waves pass through to an eye

narration.en: A 12 centimetre wave can't squeeze through a 1 millimetre hole. So it *bounces back* and heats your food.
narration.hi: 12 centimetre ki wave, 1 millimetre ke chhed se nikal hi nahi sakti. Toh wo *wapas uchhal* ke aapka khaana garam karti hai.

scenes.visual: photo of a young Indian woman in a home kitchen bending down to look through the glowing microwave door at a bowl of food turning inside, side view, warm evening light

narration.en: But light waves are thousands of times smaller than the holes, so they slip right through. That's why you can *watch* your food while the microwaves stay in. It's called a *Faraday cage*.
narration.hi: Lekin light ki waves in chhedon se hazaaron guna chhoti hain, toh wo aaraam se bahar aa jaati hain. Isliye aap khaana *dekh* sakte ho, aur microwaves andar hi rehti hain. Isse kehte hain *Faraday cage*.

scenes.visual: 2D animation: phone with a microwave thumbnail, send to a friend, comment NEXT

narration.en: Send this to the friend who stares at the microwave every time. And comment NEXT for one more everyday thing we never question.
narration.hi: Us dost ko bhejo jo har baar microwave ko ghoorta rehta hai. Aur aisi aur cheezein jaan-ni hain toh comment mein NEXT likho.
